title: JIG wave three Pololu sensor and driver carriers

records.name: A4988 Stepper Motor Driver Carrier

headers.population_notes: Male header strips supplied loose; installation requires soldering.
Male header strips supplied loose; installation requires soldering.

other_exposed_pads.notes: Current-limit reference access via is separate from the two edge headers; not counted as a header row.

evidence.geometry_method: Direct count of physical header holes in official manufacturer dimension/pinout images, combined with 0.1 inch interface and assembly documentation. Not a count of loose supplied strip length.

image_sources.caption: A4983/A4988 stepper motor driver carrier with dimensions.

caveats: Exact manufacturer SKU only; soldered-header variants and clones are not equivalent.
Actual JIG fit, retention, contact resistance, clearance and current qualification remain unknown.
Mechanical mounting holes, stitching vias and thermal vias are not connector contacts.
Motor/power pins are geometry records only. Driver current ratings do not qualify JIG contacts or permit motor-load current through an untested connection.
